# commander_classic_driver_license (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Keeper `driverLicense` (Driver's License) record by **UID**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a driver's license record by title or UID.
data "commander_classic_driver_license" "example" {
  driver_license = "_REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_TITLE_OR_UID_"
}

output "driver_license_id" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.id
}

output "driver_license_title" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.title
}

output "driver_license_notes" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.notes
}

output "driver_license_folder_location" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.folder_location
}

output "driver_license_account_number" {
  value     = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.account_number
  sensitive = true
}

output "driver_license_name" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.name
}

output "driver_license_birth_date" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.birth_date
}

output "driver_license_address_ref" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.address_ref
}

output "driver_license_expiration_date" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.expiration_date
}

output "driver_license_custom" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.custom
}

output "driver_license_share" {
  value = data.commander_classic_driver_license.example.share
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `driver_license` (String) Driver's License record **title** or **UID** to look up.

### Read-Only

- `account_number` (String, Sensitive) **Account number**.
- `address_ref` (String) **UID** of a linked record.
- `birth_date` (String) Date of **birth** (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `custom` (Attributes List) Custom fields stored in the record's `custom` array. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `expiration_date` (String) License **expiration date** (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `folder_location` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.
- `name` (Attributes) Person name (`name` field): first, middle, last. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name))
- `notes` (String) Note of the record.
- `share` (Attributes Map) Mapping of share permissions for this record. Each map **key** is a **user email**; each **value** is an object with `can_share` and `can_edit` booleans. The owner is implicit and never present in this map; the API rejects owner entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))
- `title` (String) Record title.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the value should be treated as **sensitive**.
- `type` (String) Keeper field **type** (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Field **value** (JSON-encoded for complex types).


<a id="nestedatt--name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name`

Read-Only:

- `first` (String) **First name**.
- `last` (String) **Last name**.
- `middle` (String) **Middle name**.


<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Read-Only:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow the user to edit this record. Defaults to `false`.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow the user to re-share this record with other users. Defaults to `false`.
